# Belinda

## Overview

- **Age:** 14–15 years old  <sub>[v1 c19 P78](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0078), [v1 c19 P83](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0083)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c19 P78](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0078)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c29 P3](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0003)</sub>
- **Origin:** East Welby  <sub>[v1 c21 P48](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0048)</sub>
- **Role:** Handmaiden / Domestic Servant to Miss Rosalind Penrose  <sub>[v1 c19 P78](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0078), [v1 c19 P82](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0082)</sub>
- **Titles:** Belinda the Fourth  <sub>[v1 c19 P82](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0082)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Belinda the Fourth  <sub>[v1 c19 P82](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0082)</sub>

## Appearance

Belinda the Fourth is a small, somewhat strange-looking girl with a freckled face, a snub nose, and an exceptionally wide mouth that seems to stretch from ear to ear. She has long fair hair that she wears in plaits or pigtails, often adorned with huge blue ribbon bows that stick out like wings. She possesses a very broad, cheerful smile, and although she considers herself far from attractive, she is nimble and lively in her movements.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P77](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0077), [v1 c19 P78](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0078), [v1 c25 P45](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0045)_

## Personality

Belinda is remarkably energetic, outspoken, and devoted to her mistress, Miss Rosalind. She possesses a lively curiosity and a very practical, matter-of-fact view of life that contrasts with the romantic daydreams around her. Though sometimes anxious about tasks or social formalities, she is fiercely loyal, hardworking, and quick to smile or express her emotions honestly.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P82](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0082), [v1 c19 P87](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0087), [v1 c21 P58](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0058), [v1 c25 P11](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0011), [v1 c25 P12](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0012)_

## Traits

- Loyal and devoted  <sub>[v1 c19 P92](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0092), [v1 c25 P11](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0011)</sub>
- Matter-of-fact and pragmatic  <sub>[v1 c17 P11](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0011), [v1 c25 P12](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0012)</sub>
- Energetic and industrious  <sub>[v1 c23 P0](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0000), [v1 c25 P11](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0011)</sub>
- Inquisitive  <sub>[v1 c21 P48](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0048)</sub>

## Abilities

- Domestic housework and cooking  <sub>[v1 c21 P18](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0018), [v1 c23 P0](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0000)</sub>
- Basting and sewing preparation  <sub>[v1 c22 P0](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0000)</sub>

## Goals

- To faithfully serve and care for Miss Rosalind Penrose  <sub>[v1 c19 P92](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0092), [v1 c21 P48](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0048)</sub>

## History

Belinda the Fourth came to reside at Echo Cottage in Welby at age thirteen to work as a handmaiden for Miss Rosalind Penrose. She faithfully handled the domestic duties of the small stone house and befriended Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke when they visited. During the courtship and wedding preparations of Miss Rosalind and Stephen Stanhope, Belinda worked tirelessly to assist them, despite her constant worries about things going wrong. Following Miss Rosalind's marriage, she relocated to Boston with Mr. and Mrs. Stanhope and Cedric, returning each summer to help care for Echo Cottage. Later, she married a American bricklayer named Tom and eventually settled happily in Boston.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P78](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0078), [v1 c21 P48](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0048), [v1 c23 P0](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0000), [v1 c25 P11](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0011), [v1 c25 P36](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0036), [v4 c3 P42](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0042)_

## Background by volume

- Her actual name is Leonora Bowman, but she is called 'Belinda the Fourth' because she is the fourth sister in her family to serve Miss Rosalind  <sub>[v1 c21 P48](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0048), [v1 c21 P50](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0050)</sub>
- Hails from East Welby and came to live at Echo Cottage at the age of thirteen in exchange for room, board, and clothes  <sub>[v1 c21 P48](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0048)</sub>
- Is the youngest and last of the Bowman daughters  <sub>[v1 c21 P50](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0050)</sub>

## Quotes

> There is a thing I have to state, Miss Harcourt, ma’am, and I hope you will not take it as overly bold, but keeping a secret from me is truly unkind, considering how close we have all been as friends.  <sub>[v1 c21 P48](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0048)</sub>

> It’s my hope he weds Miss Rosalind. Certain women are meant to be spinsters right from the beginning, and I fear I belong to that group, Miss Harcourt, ma’am, on account of having precious little tolerance for men.  <sub>[v1 c21 P50](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0050)</sub>

> Oh, Miss Harcourt, ma’am, what does that mean in plain language?  <sub>[v1 c21 P51](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0051)</sub>

> When all is said and done, Miss Harcourt, ma’am, a wedding isn't really much happier than a funeral.  <sub>[v1 c25 P12](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0012)</sub>

> While living in this world, a person must merely wish for the best, get ready for the worst, and accept whatever comes from God.  <sub>[v1 c25 P15](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0015)</sub>
